$comment: Higgsfield-generated assets. One entry per shipped file; keep the exact prompt so assets can be regenerated or varied.

assets.purpose: Landing hero fallback (low-FX, reduced motion, no WebGL) and art reference for the code-built R3F network core
assets.prompt: A holographic 'network core': a glowing geodesic wireframe sphere (icosahedron lattice of thin luminous lines) floating dead-center, with a faint inner energy glow. Around it, three tilted thin orbital rings carry small bright spherical data nodes, connected to the core by faint dashed light filaments. Colors: neon cyan #00e5ff and neon green #00ff9c light on a pure near-black #05070a background, with a single tiny magenta #ff2bd6 accent node. Soft bloom glow, subtle particle dust, slight depth of field. Sci-fi hacker interface aesthetic, clean, minimal, high contrast. Object fully in frame with generous dark margin on all sides, nothing touching the edges. No text, no letters, no logos, no UI, no people, no floor.
